card.name: Formulation after tablet or capsule
card.fires_on: The word "formulation" or "form" right after a dose-form word such as tablet, capsule, oral or parenteral, when the text compares or switches between dosage forms.

modes.label: Tablet/capsule formulation
modes.description: "formulation" right after tablet or capsule when one dosage form is contrasted with another.
modes.example: The starting daily dose of the tablet<< formulation>> in these patients was 2 mg,

modes.label: Oral or parenteral form
modes.description: "form" after oral or parenteral, or the end of "injectable", in switching instructions.
modes.example: The oral<< form>> should supplant the injectable as soon
